description:
FILED s542r (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-16, the round on main code cc36604b = MAIN-READY-95) from the CPAN board: HTTP-Message-7.01-0 t/message-decode-zipbomb.t went from the blessed *PLAN* "ran 5 of 9, rc 1" (#4322) to a *FILE* row "no TAP rows (rc=0)" -- SBCL dies "Heap exhausted during allocation: 66486272 bytes available, 67108880 requested" before row 1.

MEASURED (one-file runs `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows ~/.cpan/build/HTTP-Message-7.01-0 t/message-decode-zipbomb.t`, each ~35 s ALONE at load ~4; logs ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s542/round/specs/attr-d.log, attr-e.log, attr-f.log):

    MR-85 bdd36d06   5 of 9 (pass=5, SBCL rc 1)
    MR-88 a435a391   5 of 9
    MR-91 3246e41a   5 of 9
    MR-93 0df490cf   5 of 9
    MR-94 de3bf103   0 rows (heap exhausted before row 1)      <- s539a
    main  cc36604b   0 rows (twice)
    main  cc36604b   8 of 9 at PCL_DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB=1800  (s532d measured 9/9 at 1800 on its tree)

So the file's heap need is #4322's (a 16 MB byte string is a 64 MB SBCL character string; the test holds several copies), but the HEADROOM moved at s539a by enough to lose five rows at 1 GB and one row at 1.8 GB.  s539a's candidates: the TAP layer loaded from the fasl cache (#4962) and the Test::Builder method surface (#3823 #3495 #4884 #4883) -- either could keep more live data, or change when the collector runs, before the test's first allocation.

THE DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (not taken here, a measurement batch): `(sb-kernel:dynamic-usage)` after a full GC at the first `ok` of a trivial `use Test::More tests => 1; ok(1)` program on MR-93 vs MR-94 (PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1 gives the command line) -- if MR-94's live heap is ~hundreds of MB larger, the cache keeps something alive; if it is the same, the change is in allocation timing and the board row is only #4322's margin.  Either way every Test::More program pays the difference, which is why this is filed and not only keyed.

BASELINE: the board row is the *FILE* row keyed #4322 with this observation (s542r); #4322 stays the owner of the file's heap need.
subject: HEAP MARGIN (s539a, MAIN-READY-94): HTTP-Message message-decode-zipbomb.t now exhausts the 1 GB default heap BEFORE its first row (was 5 of 9 through MR-93), and stops at 8 of 9 even at PCL_DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB=1800 (s532d: 9/9 there) -- the heap a program needs grew at MR-94
